correctness.rationale: The Bergman monomial Toeplitz recurrence directly yields the first-order ODE; the normalized product solution is unique. The near-boundary root derivative yields the uniform positive kappa and complex exponent gamma. Uniform Stirling plus an Abelian power-sum theorem proves the exact Gamma norm coefficient; the second root gives a nonvanishing smooth multiplier. The disk-to-half-plane change of variables has exact Jacobian and bounded integrable majorant, establishing the normalized weak profile. Numerically verified 319 finite identities, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recently studied tridiagonal Bergman Toeplitz operators admit complete dynamical and spectral existence descriptions but previously unquantified eigenvector norm instability at ellipse boundary. The exact direction-dependent exponent range, computable Gamma coefficient and microscopic limit distribution distinguish behavior not visible from spectral membership, and identify concentration anisotropy and coefficient contrast in a motivated natural operator family.
